settings.env_file.label: Environment file
settings.env_file.description: File the API key is read from. The key never leaves this machine.
settings.key_var.label: Key variable
settings.key_var.description: Variable name inside that file holding the Synthetic API key.
settings.interval_minutes.label: Refresh minutes
settings.interval_minutes.description: How often to query the quota endpoint. Quota checks do not count against your subscription.
settings.warn_below.label: Warn below percent
settings.warn_below.description: Weekly credits remaining at or below this value switch the glyph to a warning.
settings.show_window.label: Show 5-hour window
settings.show_window.description: Also show the rolling 5-hour request window in the bar text.
